instructions: Set up the compact exercise device and secure yourself.
Alternate the cardio and resistive parts at a moderate, steady effort.
Stop if you feel pain or dizziness, then log the session.
sessions.rationale: Routine loading to protect bone and muscle.

instructions: Strap in to the cycle ergometer.
Start easy, then hold a moderate pace at which you can still talk.
Cool down at low resistance and log the session.
sessions.rationale: Routine cardio to keep the heart and blood vessels conditioned.

instructions: Stretch back, hips and shoulders slowly, without bouncing.
Breathe steadily and hold each stretch for a few breaths.
sessions.rationale: Routine mobility for the back and hips.
